control_identity.reason: All unrelated skills disabled; common security policy retained. This routing catalog is intentionally isolated.

budget.enforcement: Accounting bound: 38 max slots + 38 medium slots + two planned three-turn/one-compaction sequences. Per-panel budgets frozen separately: 180 seconds per audit/routing observer window, zero retries; corrected lifecycle240/compaction180. Initial max wrapper allowed late completions before correction; owned processes stopped and late completions excluded.
